action.instructions: Fly through every numbered gate in order. Choose pitch and bank for the next interval. Read `target.horizontal_gap_left_deg` and `target.vertical_gap_up_deg`. These signed gaps are corrections to the nearest safe edge of the gate opening. Negative horizontal gap requires RIGHT correction; positive requires LEFT. Negative vertical gap requires descent; positive requires climb. Zero gap means this motion direction already passes inside the opening. Prioritize the opening windows over the center bearing, especially immediately before crossing: center angles can grow dramatically even while the crossing is safe. When absolute horizontal gap exceeds 15 degrees, a strong bank toward the needed correction is usually appropriate. Sustain it while the gap remains large; do not reverse simply because `motion.bank_left_deg` or `measured_rates.track_turn_rate_left_deg_s` already has the desired sign. Those are evidence your turn is working, not evidence the needed correction is complete. Use `target.horizontal_gap_if_leveled_now_left_deg`, `control.estimated_extra_turn_if_leveled_left_deg` and `measured_recent_responses` to reduce bank near alignment and avoid overshoot. Keep vertical motion within `target.climb_window_up_deg`; nominal level is trim, not altitude hold. Account for measured response lag rather than reversing pitch every interval. Use `following_transition` to prepare an exit toward the following gate while still clearing the current opening. Reassess immediately when `target_update.changed_since_previous_decision` is true. Upcoming gates remain valid outside the display camera. No image is supplied. Stay within `boundary.lateral_limits_world_m`. Estimates assume unchanged motion and are approximate. Prefer the 1m interior buffer: use `target.horizontal_gap_to_interior_left_deg`, `target.vertical_gap_to_interior_up_deg` and `target.horizontal_gap_to_interior_if_leveled_left_deg` instead of correcting only after the actual opening is missed. A small gap outside the interior still needs a timely moderate correction; do not coast for several intervals until it becomes large. Aim well inside the frame, release a strong bank early enough for its remaining turn. Keep the actual opening safe when it is too late to improve the buffer. Choose one joint pitch-and-bank maneuver from the 15 choices.

action.instructions: Fly through every numbered gate in order. Choose pitch and bank for the next interval. Read `target.horizontal_gap_left_deg` and `target.vertical_gap_up_deg`. These signed gaps are corrections to the nearest safe edge of the gate opening. Negative horizontal gap requires RIGHT correction; positive requires LEFT. Negative vertical gap requires descent; positive requires climb. Zero gap means this motion direction already passes inside the opening. Prioritize the opening windows over the center bearing, especially immediately before crossing: center angles can grow dramatically even while the crossing is safe. When absolute horizontal gap exceeds 15 degrees, a strong bank toward the needed correction is usually appropriate. Sustain it while the gap remains large; do not reverse simply because `motion.bank_left_deg` or `measured_rates.track_turn_rate_left_deg_s` already has the desired sign. Those are evidence your turn is working, not evidence the needed correction is complete. Use `target.horizontal_gap_if_leveled_now_left_deg`, `control.estimated_extra_turn_if_leveled_left_deg` and `measured_recent_responses` to reduce bank near alignment and avoid overshoot. Keep vertical motion within `target.climb_window_up_deg`; nominal level is trim, not altitude hold. Account for measured response lag rather than reversing pitch every interval. Use `following_transition` to prepare an exit toward the following gate while still clearing the current opening. Reassess immediately when `target_update.changed_since_previous_decision` is true. Upcoming gates remain valid outside the display camera. No image is supplied. Stay within `boundary.lateral_limits_world_m`. Estimates assume unchanged motion and are approximate. Prefer the 1m interior buffer: use `target.horizontal_gap_to_interior_left_deg`, `target.vertical_gap_to_interior_up_deg` and `target.horizontal_gap_to_interior_if_leveled_left_deg` instead of correcting only after the actual opening is missed. A small gap outside the interior still needs a timely moderate correction; do not coast for several intervals until it becomes large. Aim well inside the frame, release a strong bank early enough for its remaining turn. Keep the actual opening safe when it is too late to improve the buffer. Choose one joint pitch-and-bank maneuver from the 15 choices.
